## Highlights

- **Correct icon in the task bar.** The running window is now associated with
  the desktop entry: the viewport carries the app id `git2pkg` and
  `git2pkg.desktop` declares `StartupWMClass=git2pkg`. Previously the window was
  grouped under a generic fallback icon (a gear) while the application menu
  showed the correct one.

## Changes

- Nothing else changed compared to `v0.2.0-alpha.37`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hyalcin70/git2pkg/compare/v0.2.0-alpha.37...v0.2.0-alpha.38
